enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Vampirism 3: This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +3d2 hit points with each hit.Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.
Life Stealing: This weapon has a chance to drain 1 to 3 levels from its target on a critical hit.
Entropic 6: This weapon is intensely powerful, and crackles with destructive, unpredictable magic. It deals an additional 6d6 untyped damage on each hit.
Malleable: This item has a magical aura of malleability and can be combined with any item that has the Fusible property to create a new, more powerful fusion of the two items.
